content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1 (max payments overtime plus outage deflection, ₹4,035), and bring in the duty manager now: even the best plan only reaches about 64% against the 80% target for 13:30-15:30.","why":"The payments spike is caused by open P1 incident INC-20261009-3059. The card authorisation gateway is failing, and card_declined calls ran at 371 against 54 expected in the last hour, so high volume will likely last until it is fixed. R1 attacks this from both sides. It offers overtime to 24 payments agents (14:00-15:00), plays IVR outage messages and deflects to chat to cut avoidable calls, and adds break delays, callbacks and cancelled payments coaching. It is predicted to lift service level from 36.7% (no action) to 63.8% over 13:30-15:30, with payments at 66.9% and general at 57.5%. Abandons are predicted to fall from 16.8% to 9.1%, and rest-of-day service level from 70.3% to 83.0%. It breaks no policy and is the best option available.","trade_offs":["R2 costs the same ₹4,035 and is slightly lower overall (61.7%; payments 64.1%, general 56.9%), with near-identical abandons (9.0% vs 9.1%), so R1 gives more for the same money.","P3 (₹3,747, 56.1%) and P4 (₹3,648, 54.9%) save about ₹300-400 but leave service level roughly 8-9 points lower and abandons at 11.0%.","P2 (₹492, 40.8%) and P1 (free, 35.9%) barely improve on doing nothing. P1 also breaks policy MOV-03, with general dropping to 66% during the 15:00-16:00 move.","General queue under R1 is predicted at 57.5%, below the 70% escalation line, but it is still better than its 46.3% with no action."],"watch":"Escalate to the duty manager: R1 is predicted at 64%, below the 70% escalation line (ESC-02), so options beyond this plan will need their decision. Track overtime uptake on the 24 offers, whether the IVR outage message and chat deflection are actually reducing payments calls, general queue service level, and the status of INC-20261009-3059. If the gateway fix runs past 15:30, the disruption window and plan will need extending."}
